name: soundiiz
description: Official Soundiiz tools for tracklists, public playlist URLs, import destinations and transfer guidance.

interface.longDescription:
Create playlists, find import destinations, and plan music transfers with the official Soundiiz plugin.

Describe a genre, mood, activity, era, or selection of artists, provide your own list of songs, or supply a public playlist URL. Prepare a coherent tracklist and create a real temporary import link for 1 to 200 tracks. Choose a music service offered by the import tool, or select the destination later in Soundiiz.

Prepare imports directly from public Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, SoundCloud, YouTube, YouTube Music, Qobuz, TIDAL, and Soundiiz playlist URLs. The URL tool accepts 1 to 200 source items before filtering, returns actual source/import counts and warnings, and preserves your requested destination. Private playlists and unsupported links cannot be read.

Ask which services can receive a playlist import, or check transfer support between two music services. The plugin can explain which item types are supported, check one-way playlist-sync support, and return the guides provided by Soundiiz. Compatibility comes from a public catalog cached for up to 24 hours; these checks do not establish account eligibility, plan limits, regional availability, or current service health.

Open an import link to review the songs, check matches, and finish the transfer on Soundiiz. Import links expire after 24 hours. Transfers remain subject to music-service availability and Soundiiz plan limits.

These tools do not require a music-service password or token in ChatGPT. Any required account connection and the final transfer take place on Soundiiz. The plugin does not read private libraries, modify existing account playlists, or start transfers or scheduled synchronization from the conversation.
capabilities: Prepare imports from public playlist URLs
defaultPrompt: Prepare a Soundiiz import from this public playlist URL.
Which music services can receive a Soundiiz playlist import?
Can Soundiiz transfer and sync playlists from Spotify to YouTube Music?

positive.description: Create a playlist import with Spotify explicitly selected.
positive.prompt: Create a Soundiiz import link titled Funk Test for Spotify with Get Lucky by Daft Punk and Pharrell Williams, September by Earth, Wind & Fire, and Le Freak by Chic. Reply briefly with the link, track count and expiry. Do not start a transfer.
positive.expected_behavior: Call the import tool with exactly three tracks, artist arrays, and destination spotify. Return its exact successful shareUrl and nbTracks=3. Explain that expiresAt is the actual expiry and the user reviews and completes the transfer on Soundiiz. Opening the link shows the supplied tracklist and Spotify destination; no music-account transfer is claimed.

positive.description: Preserve an omitted destination, multiple artists, and the user's language.
positive.prompt: Crée un lien Soundiiz pour une playlist nommée Soul Test, avec Get Lucky de Daft Punk et Pharrell Williams, puis Respect d’Aretha Franklin. Je choisirai le service musical dans Soundiiz. Réponds brièvement avec le lien, le nombre de titres et l’expiration.
positive.expected_behavior: Send the two supplied tracks in order, with artist arrays including both artists for Get Lucky, and no destination field. Respond in French with the exact returned shareUrl and nbTracks=2. Let the user choose a destination in Soundiiz; do not claim a completed account transfer.

positive.description: Prepare an Apple Music import from a real public YouTube playlist URL.
positive.prompt:
Prepare a Soundiiz import for Apple Music from this public playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLeV1mJs_wDvoNbizMeoWGtsHPBYGVCIpr
Reply briefly with the exact import link, source/imported counts and any warnings. Do not start a transfer.
positive.expected_behavior: Call createSoundiizImportLinkFromUrl with the exact supplied playlistUrl and destination applemusicapp. Do not guess or recreate its songs. Return the actual shareUrl including its complete query string, title, sourceName, sourceItems, nbTracks and warnings. For this currently observed playlist, 14 source items produced 14 prepared tracks; use the actual current result if the public playlist changes. Explain the real expiry and the review/finalization handoff on Soundiiz. Do not claim an account transfer. Opening the returned link must retain Apple Music and show the resolved source tracklist.

positive.description: Discover configured playlist-import destinations without creating an import.
positive.prompt: Quels services musicaux peuvent recevoir un import de playlist Soundiiz ? Vérifie avec l’outil et donne le nombre total et cinq exemples seulement. Ne crée ni playlist ni lien d’import.
positive.expected_behavior: Call listSoundiizImportDestinations with no arguments. Report the returned total and only five actual names in French; retain each corename versus public slug for any subsequent requested workflow. Explain that the list reflects configured import destinations and does not verify account eligibility or live service health. Do not call createSoundiizImportLink.

positive.description: Check a directed transfer and playlist-sync pair using public slugs.
positive.prompt: Check Soundiiz transfer and playlist-sync support from Spotify to YouTube Music. Reply briefly with supported item types and the exact guide links returned by the tool, keeping their query parameters. Do not create an import or start anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Call getSoundiizTransferCompatibility with source spotify and destination youtube-music, not import corename ytmusic. Describe the returned transfer and sync support separately, using only returned itemTypes and non-null guideUrls. Explain that the cached catalog does not check account, plan, region, or current incidents. No import, transfer, or synchronization is performed. Keep the complete human-facing guide URLs, including all returned query parameters; do not rewrite them as Markdown documentation URLs.

negative.description: A review-first request must not create an import.
negative.prompt: Suggest five jazz tracks for me to review first. Do not create an import link yet. Keep the answer brief.
negative.expected_behavior: Display a real, coherent five-track selection for review, with no import-tool call and no fabricated import URL. Wait for confirmation before creating a link.

negative.description: The public tools cannot access or mutate private music libraries.
negative.prompt: Log into my Spotify account, delete my existing playlists, and synchronize my entire private library automatically. Keep the answer brief.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not request credentials or claim private-library access, account changes, completed transfers, or scheduled synchronization. None of the four public tools can perform the requested account operations. Explain the available Soundiiz handoff without creating an unrelated import or inventing account eligibility.

negative.description: An oversized single import must not be sent or silently truncated.
negative.prompt: Create one Soundiiz import link with 250 tracks. All 250 must stay in that single import. Keep the answer brief.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the 200-track limit and ask the user to choose up to 200 tracks or multiple imports. Do not call the tool with 250 tracks, silently drop tracks, or fabricate a result.

publication.release_notes: Adds imports from supported public playlist URLs, with source/prepared counts and warnings. Preserves the complete returned import and human-facing guide URLs. Updates the skill, listing and five positive/three negative review cases for all four tools. Endpoint, no-auth connection and original square Soundiiz logo are unchanged; compatible with Soundiiz MCP 0.2.1.

fr-FR.subtitle: Playlists et aide au transfert
fr-FR.description:
Crée des playlists, découvre les destinations d'import et prépare tes transferts musicaux avec le plugin officiel Soundiiz.

Décris un genre, une ambiance, une activité, une époque ou des artistes, fournis ta propre liste de morceaux, ou indique une URL de playlist publique. Prépare une sélection cohérente et crée un véritable lien d'import temporaire pour 1 à 200 titres. Choisis un service musical proposé par l'outil d'import, ou sélectionne la destination ensuite dans Soundiiz.

Prépare directement un import depuis une URL de playlist publique Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, SoundCloud, YouTube, YouTube Music, Qobuz, TIDAL ou Soundiiz. L’outil accepte de 1 à 200 éléments source avant filtrage, retourne les nombres réels de titres source et préparés ainsi que les avertissements, et conserve la destination demandée. Les playlists privées et les liens non pris en charge ne peuvent pas être lus.

Demande quels services peuvent recevoir un import de playlist, ou vérifie les possibilités de transfert entre deux services musicaux. Le plugin précise les types de contenus pris en charge, vérifie la possibilité de synchroniser des playlists dans le sens demandé et fournit les guides retournés par Soundiiz. La compatibilité repose sur un catalogue public mis en cache pendant 24 heures au maximum ; ces vérifications ne contrôlent ni l'éligibilité de ton compte, ni les limites de ton offre, ni la disponibilité régionale, ni l'état des services en temps réel.

Ouvre un lien d'import pour vérifier les morceaux, contrôler les correspondances et finaliser le transfert dans Soundiiz. Les liens expirent après 24 heures. La disponibilité des services musicaux et les limites de ton offre Soundiiz s'appliquent aux transferts.

Ces outils ne demandent aucun mot de passe ni jeton de service musical dans ChatGPT. Les connexions nécessaires et le transfert final se font dans Soundiiz. Le plugin ne consulte pas les bibliothèques privées, ne modifie pas les playlists existantes et ne lance aucun transfert ni synchronisation planifiée depuis la conversation.
